g.text: A look inside the engineering behind the multiplayer platform.
Mounts NeonDash Canvas, ReactionRush, Territory, WordBlitz
• 60 FPS Decoupled Loop: zero React state re-render
• Local Player: highlighted with cyan aura ring (#22D3EE)
• Layout: flex-1 min-h-0 prevents viewport overflow
• Automatic host transfer on creator disconnection
• 20-second disconnect grace period before player eviction
• 5 Static AABB Obstacles • Monotonic Sequence Filter
• Sub-ms verified server reaction latency timestamping
• User: id, username, email, passwordHash, avatar, role
• PlayerStats: level, xp, lifetimeXp, title, wins, games
• Match & MatchParticipant: matchId, userId, score, rank
• Room: code, name, hostId, gameType, status, isPrivate
• Hosted on Neon PostgreSQL with Connection Pooling
Zero React State Re-render Overhead on Game Loop
Atomic Prisma Transaction for Match & XP Audits
